newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to trade Synetic Inc options.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to trade Synetic Inc options.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Thursday it will begin trading options on Synetic Inc on January 7.
The exchange said the options will have opening strike prices of 40, 45 and 50, with initial expirations in February, March, June and September.
Shares of Synetic were off 1-15/16 at 46-9/16 Thursday afternoon.
The PHLX said Gateway Partners will be the specialist for the new options. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
